chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow polo shirt and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s, long wavy dark brown hair, gold hoop earrings, wearing a burgundy satin house dress
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, curly black hair, thin moustache, wearing a grey hoodie with a white chest stripe and black track pants

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open doorway of a modest Casablanca apartment bedroom, head-to-waist framing: WIFE leans toward a wall mirror applying red lipstick carefully, face clearly visible, a small smile, makeup items on the dresser. Warm afternoon light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: WIFE at home in the living room twirling slightly in her burgundy satin dress, admiring herself, hair freshly styled, perfume bottle in hand, Moroccan sofa and patterned rug behind. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: WIFE in the small home kitchen still fully made up and dressed elegantly while stirring a pot, contrast between the fancy look and the ordinary chore, cheerful face. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sitting on a Moroccan sofa, frowning and quietly watching WIFE who walks past him smiling, dressed up; he raises one eyebrow, suspicious. Living room, evening lamp light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND standing in the living room, palms open, asking a question with a puzzled face; WIFE in front of him turns her head toward him, surprised. Medium shot, both faces visible. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: WIFE pointing her finger at HUSBAND, defensive and offended, arms gesturing; HUSBAND leans back, caught off guard. Living room. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE walking away angry toward the bedroom, arms crossed, looking back over her shoulder; HUSBAND alone in the hallway rubbing the back of his neck, guilty and confused. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: WIFE and FRIEND sitting on the Moroccan sofa laughing loudly together over tea glasses, leaning toward each other, very amused; a TV glows in the background. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Seen from behind HUSBAND's shoulder at the apartment front door, he holds a car-keys lanyard and a small work bag, just coming home; across the living room WIFE and FRIEND sit close on the sofa laughing, and they stop, turning toward him. HUSBAND's face in profile, tense. 2D animated cartoon style.
